title: Garden Blossoms Needlepoint Kit
description: A stunning floral arrangement featuring roses, peonies, and lavender on a rich navy background. Hand-painted on 18-mesh canvas with premium Appleton wool threads included.

title: Coastal Shells Clutch
description: Elegant seashell motifs in soft coral and sand tones, designed to be finished as a gorgeous evening clutch. Kit includes hand-painted canvas and DMC threads.

title: Chinoiserie Pagoda Pillow
description: A classic blue and white chinoiserie design featuring a temple pagoda surrounded by cherry blossoms and butterflies. Perfect for a statement pillow.

title: Monogram Passport Cover
description: Personalize your travels with this elegant monogram passport cover. Choose your letter and thread colors. Kit includes hand-painted canvas and silk threads.

title: Nutcracker Holiday Stocking
description: A festive nutcracker soldier in vibrant reds and golds, perfect for a Christmas stocking. This beloved design includes full thread kit.

title: Citrus Grove Coasters Set
description: Set of 4 cheerful citrus coaster designs — lemon, lime, orange, and grapefruit. Bright, modern, and perfect for a fun finishing project.
